name: INSEAD

class_size.cohort: typical class, two intakes per year
class_size.note: range published by the school, not an exact headcount

tuition_total.note: Inclusive of all applicable taxes; covers course materials, library, IT, student council fees, EUR 150 alumni subscription, gym, printing and health insurance. Payable in instalments (EUR 12,000 non-refundable first instalment).

mandatory_fees_total.note: No separate mandatory fees: student council, alumni subscription and health insurance are included in tuition. Optional Business Foundations Programme EUR 2,040 (August, in person) or EUR 1,530 (January, online).

living_budget_total.note: School total of EUR 30,000 (Fontainebleau) / EUR 32,000 (Singapore) includes optional items; basic_only = sum of the basic lines as listed. A partner adds roughly 30% per the school.

scholarship.note: Categories published (financial need, merit and leadership, special attributes, sustainability and social impact); no amount, count or share of class published on the pages read.

employment.cohort: Classes of December 2024 and July 2025 (929 graduates)

base_salary.note: Labelled 'annual salary' on the page; 73% of the class reported full salary information. offer_3m_pct = received at least one job offer within 3 months.

internship_monthly.note: Summer internship (Dec 2025 class per the page); 63% did an internship, project or startup tour.

employment.by_function_note: No function breakdown published; 49% changed function.
employment.employers_note: Names only, no hire counts. 257 hiring companies in 57 countries. Full list PDF: https://images.marketing.insead.edu/Web/INSEAD/{8b4802f2-0fc9-4d0e-b31f-7c1b9c7cf6d2}_2025-MBA-Employment-Statistics-Company-List.pdf

profile.note: 'Typical MBA class' figures, no intake year given; no GMAT or international share published on the page.

rankings_cited.note: INSEAD news page title; confirmed by Campus France https://www.campusfrance.org/en/financial-times-mba-ranking-2026-7-french-schools-in-the-world-s-top-100

notes: curl returns 403 on insead.edu; pages read with WebFetch. Employment statistic labelled 'salary' (not explicitly 'base').
